trap.label: suggest + objeto
trap.why: O português aceita "sugeriu-me descansar". Em inglês, suggest não leva objeto + to: use that-clause ou -ing.

opts: She prefers to cycling to driving.

mcq.q: Em qual frase that é impossível?

fix.wrong: The manager said me to wait.
fix.right: The manager told me to wait.

fix.wrong: We prefer walk than take the bus.
fix.right: We prefer walking to taking the bus.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “‘What is your job?’ he asked her.”
rewrite.answer: He asked her what her job was.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para pergunta: “You would rather eat now.”
Una com which: “London is huge. It has many parks.”
rewrite.answer: London, which has many parks, is huge.
